name: AI Lead Qualifier — score, route & draft a reply
description: Scores inbound leads 0–100 against your ideal customer profile with Gemini, logs them to a Google Sheets CRM, alerts sales on Slack for hot leads and drafts a personalised reply.

name: Invoice & Receipt Extractor — AI bookkeeping with validation
description: Turns invoices and receipts (email PDFs or pasted text) into structured, validated JSON — vendor, dates, GST/HST/PST/QST, line items and category — then logs them to an expense sheet and flags anything that doesn't add up.

name: Support Inbox Triage — classify, prioritise & draft replies
description: Reads every new support email, classifies it (billing, bug, access, cancellation, spam…), scores urgency and sentiment, escalates urgent tickets to Slack and leaves a ready-to-send draft reply in the Gmail thread.

name: Content Repurposing Engine — one article, every channel
description: Give it a blog URL or raw text and get back a LinkedIn post, an X thread, a newsletter blurb, an Instagram caption, hooks and hashtags in your brand voice — optionally queued in a Google Sheets content calendar.

name: Appointment Reminders & No-show Recovery
description: For salons, clinics and service businesses: sends 24-hour and 2-hour SMS/email reminders from your booking system every 15 minutes, and turns no-shows into rebookings with a personalised AI message.

name: Weekly KPI Report — numbers + AI executive summary
description: Every Monday at 8am: pulls the last 14 days of orders from Postgres, computes week-over-week KPIs, has Gemini write a plain-English executive summary with wins, risks and actions, and emails a clean HTML report and a Slack digest.

name: Global Error Alerts — Slack + email when any workflow fails
description: Set this as the error workflow for every production workflow: failures are posted to Slack and emailed with the workflow, failing node, error message and a direct link to the execution.
